info.name: Vopay PayPal Endpoints API
info.description:
Operations tagged PayPal Endpoints across 2 of this provider's published API definitions: vopay-payment-method-api-reference.json, vopay-payment-rails-api-reference.json. Each path carries the servers of the definition it was published in.

Contact Support:
 Name: API Support
 Email: help@vopay.com

urlencoded.description: (Required) Your account ID
(Required) API key for the account
(Required) Hashed signature for the request
(Required) The type of the PayPal account identifier. Valid values are 'EMAIL', 'PHONE', 'PAYPAL_ID'.
(Required) The recipient ID (email address, phone number, or PayPal ID) of the PayPal account. This value corresponds with the PayPalRecipientType value in the request.
(Required) The full name of the PayPal account holder.
Client Account ID
The ID of the contact to use for this PayPal account.
3 character currency code for the currency to be charged to the customer's PayPal wallet. If this is not specified the transaction will use the account's local currency.

request.description: This endpoint is used to look up and return the full details on a single PayPal withdraw transaction. PayPal withdraw send funds from your VoPay account to the customer's PayPal account.

urlencoded.description: (Required) Your account ID
(Required) API key for the account
(Required) Hashed signature for the request
(Required) The full name of the recipient receiving the funds.
(Required) The amount to send to the customers PayPal wallet.
Client Account ID
The ID of the contact to use for this transaction. The contacts payment method associated with this transaction type will be used.
The token identifying the PayPal wallet to send funds to.
The type of the PayPal wallet you are sending funds to. Valid values are 'EMAIL', 'PHONE', 'PAYPAL_ID'.
The recipient ID (email address, phone number, or PayPal ID) of the PayPal wallet you are sending funds to. This value corresponds with the PayPalRecipientType value in the request.
3 character currency code for the currency to be charged to the customer's PayPal wallet. If this is not specified the transaction will use the account's local currency.
Optional notes for the transaction.
Optional client reference number for the transaction.
A unique key which the server can use to recognize and reject subsequent retries of the same request.
An optional unique identification general ledger code.

CPA transaction code. Use the /api/v2/account/transactions/codes endpoint to retrieve a list of valid transaction codes. If not specified, the transaction will be created using code 450 (miscellaneous).

request.description:

If a ClientAccountID is provided, the client account's default PayPal wallet will be used for the transaction.
